source.author: verg
source.text: Hanc aram luco statuit, quae maxuma semper dicetur nobis et erit quae maxuma semper.
source.text_original: Hanc aram luco statuit, quae maxuma semper / dicetur nobis et erit quae maxuma semper.
source.text_english: He set up this altar in the grove, which shall always be said by us to be the greatest, and shall always be the greatest.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text_english: Then they gladly set up altars.
